children: Newly Created Role Deepens Lazard's Equity Capital Markets Advisory Capabilities in North America

) has announced that Daniel Burton-Morgan has joined the firm in a newly created role as a Managing Director and Head of Equity Capital Markets Advisory, North America, within the Strategic Capital Solutions Group, based in New York.

The new role reflects Lazard's commitment to fully servicing clients across all of their capital markets needs. Daniel will play a central role in advising clients on equity capital markets strategy and execution, including initial public offerings, follow-on and secondary offerings, and block trades. His experience spans more than two decades.

"Daniel is an experienced and accomplished equity capital markets banker, with a global track record that speaks for itself across IPOs, block trades and sponsor relationships," said Tim Donahue, Global Head of Strategic Capital Solutions and Co-Head of Financial Advisory in North America at Lazard. "Lazard has long operated a robust ECM advisory franchise in Europe. Daniel's arrival establishes the same capability across North America, giving boards and management teams a seamless offering globally."

"Lazard has built deep, trusted relationships with corporates and sponsors, and a reputation for candid, strategic advice," said Daniel Burton-Morgan. "I'm excited to join the team and help clients access the full range of capital markets solutions they need, at the right time and on the right terms."

Prior to joining Lazard, Daniel spent his career at Bank of America, most recently as Head of Americas ECM Financial Sponsor Origination. Daniel holds a First-Class degree in Management Science from the University of Warwick.

Founded in 1848, Lazard is the preeminent financial advisory and asset management firm, with operations in North and South America, Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and Australia. Lazard provides advice on mergers and acquisitions, capital markets and capital solutions, restructuring and liability management, geopolitics, and other strategic matters, as well as asset management and investment solutions to institutions, corporations, governments, partnerships, family offices, and high net worth individuals. Lazard is listed on the New York Stock Exchange as Lazard, Inc. under the ticker LAZ. For more information, please visit Lazard.com and follow Lazard on LinkedIn.
